summary: Added 4 novel features across 3 files: --watch (async poll until completed), --download (save exportUrl to disk), --image-source (shorthand for --image-options-source), --sharing (preset shorthand for workspace/external access combos). New file generations_watch.go provides watchGenerationStatus(), downloadExportFile(), and applySharingPreset() helpers.
reason: Phase 3 transcendence — the Gamma API is async-first (POST returns a generationId, poll until completed). Without --watch, users must manually poll get-status in a loop. --watch bridges this gap and --download makes the result immediately usable without a second curl command.
validated_outcome: Novel flags verified: --watch polls until completed, --sharing preset sets workspaceAccess+externalAccess, --image-source maps to imageOptions.source. dogfood quick level: 17/17 PASS.
